none: PAS IOW-B55E35: Roman Coin: Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius
contea di ritrovamento: Isle of Wight (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and worn Roman copper-alloy nummus of Magnentius or Decentius, dating to the period AD 351-353 (Reece period 18). [VICTOR]IAE DD NN AVG ET [CAE] reverse type depicting Two Victories holding a shield inscribed VOT/V/MVLT/X, no supporting column. Mint of Lyon. Mint: SV//[...]. Obverse: [...], Uncertain draped(?) bust right. Reverse: [VICTOR]IAE DD NN AVG ET [CAE] reverse type…
